en: A black and white photograph on a postcard depicting a peaceful European village scene. There is a stone arched bridge in the foreground with grassy banks and trees lining the road. In the background are several historic houses, some with steeply pitched roofs typical of Central Europe. Two figures stand near one of the buildings, and another bridge or footpath can be seen further along the road.
